description: Write SEO-optimized blog posts, landing pages, and long-form page copy following Google's E-E-A-T and Helpful Content guidelines. Handles new content creation from a keyword, topic, or brief, and full-page rewrites. Use when asked to "write a blog post", "create a landing page", "write content about X", "content for keyword X", "draft an article", "blog post about", "landing page for", "service page", "product page copy", "rewrite this page", "how-to guide", or "listicle". NOT for analyzing/auditing existing content (seo-geo-optimizer, content-quality-auditor), title tags or meta descriptions (meta-tags-optimizer), or keyword expansion (keyword-research) — those skills own their triggers.
